visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a view from the back seat of a moving vehicle. A child with black hair is seen from behind, looking out the left passenger window. Outside, a red sedan and a white van with vibrant orange and yellow graphics pass quickly on a highway. The background is a flat, desolate brown field under a dense, overcast grey sky. (2) The child shifts their head to the right, tracking a vivid rainbow that appears to bridge across the horizon. The interior of the car features white quilted leather seats and a black tablet mount attached to the front passenger headrest. The lighting is soft and natural, typical of a rainy or cloudy day. (3) The child points towards the window as the camera pans slightly. A secondary, fainter rainbow (double rainbow) becomes visible in the sky above the primary one. The vehicle continues to move, showing the highway barrier and the expansive flat topography beyond it.

A child's voice, high in pitch and with high arousal, exclaims in English: 'That's a full rainbow!'
